title: ASEAN countries sign world's first region-wide digital economy pact, laying foundation for collaboration
paragraphs: ASEAN countries sign world's first region-wide digital economy pact, laying foundation for collaboration
Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong said the pact took several years to negotiate and reflects the diverse state of readiness among member countries.

MANILA: Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) member states on Saturday (Nov 14) signed the world's first region-wide, legally binding Digital Economy Framework Agreement (DEFA), with Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong describing the pact as reflecting the diverse state of readiness among member countries.
